title: Locked decisions (§0.2)
description: The structure of the §0.2 'Locked decisions' table in a TINS consumer's SPEC.md. Validated by the kit's validate.mjs §8.1.

decisions.description: The list of locked decisions, in order (D1, D2, ...).

id.description: The decision id (D1, D2, ...). Sequential, no gaps.

title.description: The one-line title of the decision.

why.description: The 1–2 sentence rationale. Must be specific (e.g. 'because X library doesn't support Y', not 'because it's better').

alternatives_considered.description: Optional: the alternatives the spec author considered and rejected.

revisit_when.description: Optional: the trigger that would cause this decision to be re-opened (e.g. 'when X library reaches 1.0', 'when the project exceeds 100 tenants').
